Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire in that direction only (never move the player). E places a bomb at the player's feet. Space and Q were inert in an earlier run (Space even with Tech X held); do not retry them. Death state shows a bloodied X-eyed body with all heart outlines empty; the run is over. Item slot can already hold something at run start (icon uncertain).

TECH X (observed): obtained by stepping onto the green/white pill floating over the two-poop room's central rock (earlier also from a red treasure chest); the pill sits right at the room's top-hatch landing point. Grants goggles and persists across rooms. Firing spawns a laser ring ahead that lingers, grinds overlapping targets, then fades. Ring placement is unreliable: when firing left it appears ~0.10-0.11 of room width left of the player, with a small varying vertical offset. Precise aiming is impossible - reposition the player instead of holding fire. ~0.8-1.5s sustained fire per target. Destroys brown poop piles (dropping a coin), cracks rocks and chests (red crack outlines). Destroyed the two-poop room's central rock with no passage revealed. NO effect observed on: the small golden '$'-faced coin object, the rock-field room's golden wall door/fixture, a hopper's spiky shell (hopper burst out and cost a heart), or red-lidded/key-locked chests. Props REGENERATE on room re-entry (central rock, poop piles, rock rings, spike rings), so grinding a room's props is pointless.

COINS (observed): the small golden '$'-faced round object dropped by a destroyed poop pile is a real coin; collect by near-exact overlap while walking (count went 00->01). Laser ignores coins. Faint gold specks/motes elsewhere are probably decorative.

CHESTS (observed): gray metal chests open by firing into them, or by contact once enemies are dead; drops included a heart+bomb orb and a heart; a heart at full hearts converted to +1 bomb. The torch room's central gray chest embedded in a rock ring resisted contact (no enemies alive) and laser; its rocks seem to regenerate - likely key-locked. In the dark chest room, two corner red-lidded chests resisted many laser hits (key or mimic guess); a spike-ringed central red chest stayed closed; contact with a corner chest cost several hearts at once (mimic/spike guess, unconfirmed).

BOMBS (observed): E places at feet; the blast damages the player - a 0.5s retreat was not enough, retreat far. A bomb inside a rock pocket cleared rocks but cost a heart. Bombing the white spike ring removed no spikes. Bombing cracked/stained wall patterns did nothing (decorative).

HAZARDS (observed): black spiders in the dark chest room are melee chasers and lethal - they drained the final heart at the tutorial's right doorway (hazard reaches the doorway). White round-faced hoppers in the rock-field room are extremely dangerous: they teleport/phase (white puffs), ring themselves with spiky gray rocks, leave green splatter clouds and green blobs that damage on contact, and can burst in a green explosion. Their shells are unstable (hopper burst free, walked, then re-shelled). Lasering a shelled hopper costs a heart rather than killing it. Corner torches damage on contact. Diagonal rock chains block both straight and diagonal movement; pure single-axis moves work better, and when wedged use one pure single-axis move into open floor. Hazard contact cost 1-3 hearts per hit.

TRANSITIONS (observed): bottom gold trapdoors descend with centered sustained S; top crown hatches warp from centered below with sustained W; trapezoid doorways are ordinary connections needing sustained walking plus fairly precise centering. Confirmed routes: tutorial TOP trapezoid -> rock-field room; tutorial BOTTOM trapezoid -> torch room; torch room TOP alcove -> tutorial room (loop; needs tight x~0.50); torch room BOTTOM gold trapdoor -> two-poop room; two-poop room TOP crown hatch -> torch room; tutorial RIGHT-wall doorway (vertical band ~y0.47, must be near the doorway's vertical center) -> dark chest room. MAP CORRECTION: rock-field room's BOTTOM trapezoid -> torch room's TOP alcove (not the tutorial room). Torch room's right-wall marking (~x0.79, y0.33-0.55) is DECORATIVE - pushes at many heights failed. The two-poop room has NO bottom exit; its bottom wall cracks are decorative and its only exit is the top crown hatch.

MAP (observed): Tutorial room (wall hints, top+bottom trapezoid doors, right-wall doorway y~0.47). Below -> torch room (central gray chest in triangular rock ring, four corner torches, brown poop pile, top alcove back to tutorial, bottom gold trapdoor). Below that -> two-poop room (central rock, two poop piles - right destructible, left a dark blob that absorbed many hits and never broke, Tech X pill, top crown hatch only). Tutorial top -> rock-field room (many gray rocks, golden door/fixture on left wall ~x0.20,y0.50, hoppers and green clouds, bottom trapezoid). Tutorial right -> dark chest room (corner red-lidded chests, spike-ringed central red chest, black spiders).

ROCK-FIELD TOP DOOR (unresolved/negative): repeated centered sustained W attempts at x~0.46-0.54, durations 0.2-2.0s, all failed to transition; a hopper phasing there cost a heart once. Best guess: decorative alcove or blocked, though a hopper interfering is not ruled out. Do not gamble many hearts on it.

GOLDEN WALL DOOR (unresolved): rock-field room left wall, keyhole-framed; contact and laser did nothing - likely a locked door needing a key, or decorative.

SUGGESTED CAUTION (hypothesis): rock-field room is lethal even at 3 hearts; leave it at 2+ hearts rather than exploring further, since contact is fatal at 1 heart.

UNEXPLORED: whether anything opens the two locked chest types; any source of keys (HUD always 00); where health drops come from (cleared rooms rarely dropped hearts).

FAILED STRATEGIES: contact/laser-opening locked or mimic chests without keys; firing while too close (ring overshoots); bombing spike rings and decorative wall cracks; lingering near hoppers/green clouds/spiders at low health; lasering a shelled hopper; assuming an open-looking lane is clear; hugging corner torches;
